plugins.name: iminify
plugins.description: Compress, convert and resize images with AI alt text, and scan web pages for every image they load, with Iminify. Includes skills that optimize a project's images and write the smaller files back, give them alt text and descriptive file names, and fix the images behind a page's Core Web Vitals.
